header.description: What: on berlin (flat, empty) a dismounted STOCHASTIC 'Blue Stochastic Platoon' (30 men) is ordered to move 2 km east, (100,300) to (2100,300), by the generic Move play. Judge: it marches as a column (Formation Column), its route is the straight 2000 m leg, and its TAIL arrives within +-10 % of M-2's predicted time: (2000 + 145 m column) / (1.5 m/s x 0.9) = 1589 s, so between 1430 s and 1748 s. Fail: it arrives outside that window, or not as a column. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh agg-march-open (~6 min)
